core.label: Search and read
core.why: the scripture, one index that reads both Gurmukhi and Latin queries, and the model to embed a query

translations.label: Translations and the Darpan
translations.why: what ?tr= attaches, and the darpan block on /api/shabad

english.label: English meaning search
english.why: an English index and its model, so /api/text answers English well and index=all has a second voter

punjabi-extra.label: A third voter
punjabi-extra.why: a second Gurmukhi index sharing the core model, so index=all fuses three sources

extra-indexes.label: Every index
extra-indexes.why: the remaining two meaning sources; more votes, more memory

fixtures.label: Parity fixtures
fixtures.why: reference_topk.json beside each index, so the JS-vs-Python parity tests can run against a fetched deployment instead of skipping
